chapter: Society work, Camilla Todd and Storyville
title: Overwork: funerals with Moret and Celestin plus nightly jobs
summary: He says he could not refuse either leader and worked nights and parades without a night off.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: And that's how it come to kill me too. That's all, because if I didn't play with him, those funerals I had to play with Mr. Moret, that was the excelsior. Because manual parade wasn't there, this fella wasn't there, that fella wasn't there, in other words he didn't have no musician in Syrman, they were always there. And so all those parade and funerals, it was he polite, Charles.

And that's why I made my mistake. I wouldn't refuse Mr. Moret because he'd get hot. I wouldn't refuse Celestan because he'd get hot. So therefore when one didn't have it, the other one had it, you see. But I had to play with them, both of them. And then playing my Knight work, every night, every night, every night, no night off.
